name: 98055 · Renton, WA
findings: ZIP 98055 (Renton) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98055 (Renton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98055 (Renton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
